writes.spec/new_classes_definition.md:
# new_classes

For each firm-year (filing year), the number of CPC subclasses in which the firm files a later-granted patent for the first time, counting all listed classes, with first-time measured over the firm's full patent history in the data. A firm-year with no patents has new_classes = 0.

F2.reason: The definition's last sentence sets the empty case to 0

F3.reason: Panel edge is a design choice for the human; default is to flag the first two years

F4.reason: Their robustness table uses filing year; the citation stands

F2.output: fake case: firm with zero patents in 2003 -> new_classes 0 (passes under the current definition)

F4.change: citation corrected to the robustness table
